item.aggregatedOutput:
usage: prepare_instructions.py [-h] [--profile PROFILE] [--load LOAD]
                               [--skip SKIP]
                               {bootstrap,profiles,checklists}

Package original review instructions for complete, bounded Read calls. This
helper never opens subject files or evaluates profile predicates. It checks
instruction membership/completeness and prints paths to read, not a review
gate.

positional arguments:
  {bootstrap,profiles,checklists}

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --profile PROFILE
  --load LOAD
  --skip SKIP
